title: Booking sheet for the owner
summary: One booking on the company side, or a new encaixe: service, person, date, time and customer, with Remarcar, Cancelar, Não veio, and Aceitar or Recusar for a requested booking.

businessId.description: Matrix ID of the company account.

serviceId.description: The Catálogo item of kind service.

serviceName.description: The service name, from the business's public services or the owner's catalogue.

agendaName.description: Name of the person or station.

start.description: Start, shown in the phone's time zone and locale.

customerUserId.description: The customer's Matrix ID. Absent for a name-only booking.

customerName.description: Name-only customer (encaixe). Absent for a signed-in customer.

mode.description: new makes an encaixe; existing shows a booking.

customerUserId.description: A person picked from the business's DMs.

customerName.description: A typed name, for someone with no Bipe account.

save.effect: New: POST /v1/me/business/agenda/bookings (source owner). Existing with a new time or person: POST .../bookings/{id}/move. slot_taken shows bipe_agenda_error_slot_taken.

cancel.effect: Asks bipe_agenda_cancel_confirm, then POST .../bookings/{id}/cancel. The customer sees the card change.

noShow.effect: POST .../bookings/{id}/no-show. Shown only after the start.

openChat.effect: Opens the DM with the signed-in customer.

notes: The owner can place an encaixe outside the published hours; only an overlap with another booking is refused.
A name-only booking gets no card and no reminder (ADR 0100, bipe_agenda_walk_in_hint).
